lines.zh: 我贴着河底滑，水草让开。
lines.en: I glide along the riverbed; the weeds part.

lines.zh: 长身子一摆，我窜出三格。
lines.en: One sweep of my long body carries me three blocks.

lines.zh: 我在小湖里巡自己的地盘。
lines.en: I patrol my own stretch of the small lake.

lines.zh: 一两条同伴跟在我后面。
lines.en: One or two kin trail behind me.

lines.zh: 我的背是深绿的，水底看不清。
lines.en: My back is dark green, hard to spot on the bed.
I swim slowly, like a sunken log.

lines.zh: 从深处往浅处，我一步步挪。
lines.en: From deep to shallow, I work my way up.

lines.zh: 河底的石头从我腹下过。
lines.en: River stones slide beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 我拐弯时，整个身子先弯。
lines.en: Turning, my whole body bends first.
I do not look at the light on the surface.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，小鱼都躲了。
lines.en: Small fish hide wherever I pass.
The water is cold in winter; I patrol anyway.
This bend of the river answers to me.

lines.zh: 我先绕一圈，再决定停哪。
lines.en: I circle once before choosing where to rest.

lines.zh: 我从水草边滑出去，很快。
lines.en: I slip out from the weeds, fast.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边走，影子在底下。
lines.en: I run along the bank, shadow below.

lines.zh: 湖心的水凉，我绕了一圈。
lines.en: The lake center is cold, so I circle once.

lines.zh: 我慢慢游回自己的浅湾。
lines.en: I drift back to my own shallow bay.

lines.zh: 我悬在水草边，一动不动。
lines.en: I hover by the weeds without moving.
Frost on the river and I am still awake.
A frog calls from the bank.
I count the small fish swimming past.
The current pushes me; I cannot be bothered.
I am waiting for something careless.
The lake is small, enough for one fish like me.
I open my mouth, then close it.
Autumn water, cool to my liking.

lines.zh: 我在水底听岸上的脚步。
lines.en: On the bottom, I listen to footsteps ashore.
The old fish of this river fear me.

lines.zh: 我尾鳍轻摆，把身子钉在原处。
lines.en: A soft tail beat pins me in place.
Only after dark do I begin to move.

lines.zh: 有东西落水了，我听见了。
lines.en: Something hit the water; I heard it.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: You are on the bank; I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 那根竿上的线，我咬断过两次。
lines.en: I have bitten through that rod's line twice.
I lift my head just enough to show my eyes.
You are standing on my riverbank.
Bending low like that, are you going to scoop me up?
I do not fear you; the water is mine.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水面上，太吵。
lines.en: Your shadow on the water is noisy.
Standing that long, do your legs not ache?

lines.zh: 你在明处，我在暗处，扯平了。
lines.en: You in the light, me in the dark; we are even.
One move from you and I dive.
Who bit me? I turn and ram in answer.
Scales come off and blood fills the water.

lines.zh: 疼，我的长身子扭成一团。
lines.en: It hurts; my long body twists into a coil.
I slip half a block aside, teeth still bare.
This wound is light; I can still charge.

lines.zh: 我退进水草，先看看是谁。
lines.en: I back into the weeds to see who it was.
Five hearts, enough to take a few blows.

lines.zh: 我被拍在河底，泥都起来了。
lines.en: Slapped onto the bed, I kick up mud.

lines.zh: 你打中了，可你还在岸上。
lines.en: You hit me, but you are still on the bank.

lines.zh: 你身上那股铁味，我记下了。
lines.en: I have noted the iron smell on you.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼，你举得太高了。
lines.en: That small fish is held too high.
I eat what still moves; dead things I leave.
Try tossing it into the water.
I smell blood, and it is fish blood.
That smell sets my gums itching.
No rush to eat; first I study you.
Lower the bait and I will come.
Too small even to wedge between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，又回到饵边。
lines.en: I circle once and come back to the bait.

lines.zh: 这次我咬，连你的手一起。
lines.en: This time I bite, and your hand with it.
You lunge; I snap my tail and bounce clear.
Between us we have muddied the water.
My body is slick; you cannot hold me.

lines.zh: 别用网，网会缠住我的牙。
lines.en: No nets; they snag on my teeth.

lines.zh: 我撞回你一下，算礼尚往来。
lines.en: I bump you back; fair exchange.

lines.zh: 我从你膝盖边滑过去，不溅水花。
lines.en: I slip past your knee without raising a splash.
You step down and the bed turns to mud.

lines.zh: 我被挤到水草里，缠了一下。
lines.en: Shoved into the weeds, I tangle for a moment.
I wrench free and come around again.
I will remember that collision.

lines.zh: 开春水暖，我才想这件事。
lines.en: Only when spring warms the water do I think of it.
The female waits in the shallows among the weeds.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，尾巴缠尾巴。
lines.en: We swim abreast, tails entwined.
She scatters eggs over the weeds.

lines.zh: 我在旁边守着，赶走别的鱼。
lines.en: I guard beside her and drive off other fish.
There are many eggs; I stop counting.
That female is a little longer than I am.
Once done, I am fiercely hungry.

lines.zh: 我们的幼鱼会藏在水草里。
lines.en: Our fry will hide among the weeds.
This shallows will see us again next year.

lines.zh: 有东西落水，我咬了一下。
lines.en: Something fell in; I bit it once.
Hard, not fish; I spat it out.
I push it down with my snout.
What good is this scrap of iron?

lines.zh: 我把它叼到水草里藏起来。
lines.en: I carry it into the weeds and hide it.
Too heavy; I drag it half a block.
It glinted and I took it for a minnow.

lines.zh: 我咬住又松口，牙有点疼。
lines.en: I bite, then release; my teeth ache.
I circle it twice and swim off.
This thing squats on my territory.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼探出头，我看见了。
lines.en: A small fish peeks out; I have spotted it.
I flatten myself and prepare to dash.
Four blocks away, one dart will do.
I choose it because it is slowest.
I have its flank in my sights.

lines.zh: 这次不落空，我有五成把握。
lines.en: This time I will not miss; I give it even odds.
It swims into the shallows, easier to take.

lines.zh: 目标定了，我尾鳍绷成一张弓。
lines.en: Target chosen; my tail fin bends like a bow.

lines.zh: 猎物还没发现水草在动。
lines.en: The prey has not noticed the weeds stirring.

lines.zh: 尾巴绷到极限，我就冲出去。
lines.en: My tail wound to its limit, I spring.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底靠近，一点水声都没有。
lines.en: I creep along the bed without a sound.
It turns its head; I stop at once.
Weeds block me, so I go around.

lines.zh: 再近两格，就是我的距离。
lines.en: Two blocks closer and it is my range.
My long snout is aimed at it.
It panics, and panic makes it slow.
I follow behind, in no hurry.
It flees deeper; that suits me.
My shadow falls across it.
This is the moment; I lunge.
I dart and my teeth sink into its flank.
It whips its tail; I bite deeper.
I drag it into the weeds.
That bite breaks its spine.
It still struggles; I keep my grip.
I shake my head and tear it open.
Blood clouds the water, thick and strong.
It goes still and I swallow it down.

lines.zh: 有别的鱼来抢，我撞开它。
lines.en: Another fish comes to steal; I ram it aside.
After eating, scales still cling to my mouth.

lines.zh: 我从河底的石缝里出来。
lines.en: I come out of a crack in the riverbed.

lines.zh: 第一条看见的是水草和泥。
lines.en: The first things I see are weeds and mud.
This river has no master yet.
I swing my long body and try speed.

lines.zh: 比我大的鱼在远处看我。
lines.en: Bigger fish watch me from a distance.
I hide in the weeds until they leave.
The water is cold, and I like it.
From today, this stretch is mine.
I have memorized this river bend.

lines.zh: 我要长到一米四那么长。
lines.en: I mean to reach one meter forty.
The water boils and I thrash inside it.

lines.zh: 我被甩上岸，拍在石头上。
lines.en: Flung ashore, I slap against the stone.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里翻着，腮里全是泥。
lines.en: I flop in the shallows, gills packed with mud.
The blast turns the whole river over.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的背，沉了一半。
lines.en: An arrow drives into my back and I sink halfway.

lines.zh: 一股怪力把我钉在水底。
lines.en: A strange force pins me to the bottom.

lines.zh: 河里的鱼都躲着我，我饿。
lines.en: Every fish hides from me, and I starve.

lines.zh: 雷电顺水劈下来，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the water and numbs me.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吸走，河底都看不见了。
lines.en: The void pulls me away until the riverbed is gone.
